description: AI-Enhanced Judicial & Legal Services Platform (AI-JLSP) - Kenya Judiciary & KRA

scripts.dev: docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d && npm --prefix packages/frontend run dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/frontend run build && npm --prefix packages/backend run build

scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/frontend run test && npm --prefix packages/backend run test
